content.title: Trump’s Marijuana Order Spurs Stock Selloff, but Praise From Cannabis Executives
content.summary: Cannabis stocks were mostly lower Thursday in volatile trading after President Trump signed an executive order directing the federal government to reclassify marijuana as a lower-risk drug.  Green Thumb Industries (GTBIF) fell about 14%, Trulieve Cannabis (TCNNF) dropped roughly 18%, and the AdvisorShares Pure U.S. Cannabis ETF (MSOS) slid 21%, erasing earlier gains.  The declines suggest disappointment that the order doesn’t legalize marijuana federally or address banking access and interstate commerce, longstanding constraints on U.S. cannabis businesses.
